modes.simple: Welspun Living is spending Rs 3,200 crore to build bigger factories for towels, weaving, and yarn by late 2028.

summary: Welspun Living plans to invest Rs 3,200 crore to expand its production capacity by December 2028. The proposed expansion includes 29,000 metric tonnes of additional annual terry towel capacity, 15,000 metric tonnes of weaving capacity, and 31,000 metric tonnes of yarn capacity. This capital expenditure aims to scale up manufacturing operations over the next few years. Indian retail investors tracking textile sector leaders will note the long-term capital commitment.

headline: Textile sector reports strong growth and improved margins
hook: Textile sector sees strong 2Q earnings recovery
summary: The Indian textile sector posted 26% YoY revenue growth in 2QFY27, driven by higher realizations and improved order execution. Apparel and home textile players saw significant margin expansion, while spinning companies benefited from high capacity utilization and wider yarn-cotton spreads. Analysts highlight Gokaldas Exports and Pearl Global as key beneficiaries of global sourcing shifts and capacity expansion. Retail investors should note that while the outlook is positive, future performance depends on managing input cost inflation and maintaining export demand.
why_it_matters: Textile stocks may see momentum from improved export order visibility.

headline: Eight BSE 500 stocks deliver over 100% returns since Diwali 2025 despite broader market consolidation
hook: Eight BSE 500 stocks double despite weakness
summary: While the Nifty 50 declined nearly 3% since Diwali 2025, eight BSE 500 stocks more than doubled investors' wealth, led by Aditya Infotech with 191% gains and HFCL with 186%. ACE Equities data shows only 190 stocks from the index posted positive returns during this period of broader market weakness. Major brokerages including ICICI Direct and Motilal Oswal remain constructive on Samvat 2083, projecting double-digit earnings growth and favoring sectors like BFSI, manufacturing, and consumption. For retail investors, the data underscores that selective stock picking has outperformed the broader index significantly over the past year.
whats_next: Samvat 2083 equity performance and corporate earnings delivery
why_it_matters: Stock selection matters more than broad index growth in weak markets.
winners_losers: Niche large gainers gain / broader index laggards hurt
